title: CAIMS: Scalable Cross-Array In-Memory Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.25141v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Search, especially top-k similarity search, plays a vital role in many applications, but its performance can be severely limited by memory access overhead. In-memory search (IMS), an alternative to CPU/GPU-based approaches, exploits massive parallelism within a content-addressable memory (CAM) array to perform search in situ and provides both low latency and high energy efficiency. However, the capacity of a single CAM array is often insufficient for modern workloads, requiring data to be distributed across multiple arrays. Deploying scalable top-k similarity search across multiple CAM arrays poses a fundamental problem that existing designs fail to address: how to accurately and efficiently reduce local binary match results to global top-k results. translated_title: CAIMS：可扩展的跨阵列存内搜索
translated_abstract: 搜索，尤其是top-k相似度搜索，在许多应用中扮演着至关重要的角色，但其性能可能严重受限于内存访问开销。存内搜索（In-Memory Search, IMS）作为基于CPU/GPU方法的替代方案，利用内容寻址存储器（CAM）阵列内部的大规模并行性来就地执行搜索，同时提供低延迟和高能效。然而，单个CAM阵列的容量通常不足以应对现代工作负载，因此需要将数据分布在多个阵列上。跨多个CAM阵列部署可扩展的top-k相似度搜索带来了一个现有设计未能解决的根本性问题：如何准确且高效地将局部二进制匹配结果归约为全局top-k结果。本工作提出了CAIMS，一个与存储技术和应用无关的跨阵列存内搜索框架，能够实现可扩展且高效的top-k相似度搜索，同时保持准确性。
tldr: CAIMS提出了一个与存储技术和应用无关的跨阵列存内搜索框架，通过准确高效地将局部匹配结果归约为全局top-k结果，解决了跨多个CAM阵列进行可扩展top-k相似度搜索的关键难题。
en_tdlr: CAIMS is a technology- and application-agnostic cross-array in-memory search framework that enables scalable and efficient top-k similarity search across multiple CAM arrays by accurately and efficiently reducing local binary match results to global top-k results.
